title: Avimi Nota’ah
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Avodah Zarah 36b: “Bali said that Avimi Nota’ah said in Rav’s name: Their bread and their oil are among the eighteen matters.” Shabbat 17b reads “Bali said that Avimi Sanvata’ah said”; Hyman proposes the reading as in Avodah Zarah, and so it is in Dikdukei Soferim. (It is a place-name, as in Shabbat 121b, and so it is cited in the Arukh, entry נוות.)
